LESS TO HOLD IN YOUR HEAD

Small steps.
Lighter days.

A long list can feel like a hundred decisions at once. FocusMail gives you one conversation and a clear next step.

01 / INVITE YOUR MAIL IN

Start when you’re ready.

Connect your account, then press Sync inbox. FocusMail checks for mail when you ask. It doesn’t fetch new messages in the background.

02 / MAKE ONE DECISION

Give it a next step.

Reply, delegate, snooze, archive, or move to Trash. Sending a reply or forward includes a choice to archive the original conversation in its own account.

03 / ASK FOR A LITTLE CLARITY

A thinking partner, if you want.

Use your chosen AI service to summarize a conversation or draft a reply. Optional priority sorting assesses new emails and keeps its results locally.

CLEAR BY DESIGN

Your mail has
a place to stay.

The desktop app connects to your mail provider directly. You don’t need a separate FocusMail cloud account.

Your email stays in a local cache until you choose an action that shares it: sending, forwarding, or asking your selected AI service for help.
Read the privacy policy ↗
  • Sign in with your provider.

    Google and Microsoft sign-in happen on the provider’s website. FocusMail stores the resulting tokens encrypted locally. Other accounts can use IMAP/SMTP credentials.

  • Choose your AI service.

    Configure an API endpoint, model and key. Chat shares the selected thread; manual prioritization shares new individual emails. Neither runs just because you sync.

  • Keep the last word.

    AI drafts wait for your review. The app doesn’t send replies or delegate mail on its own. Provider access can be revoked in your Google or Microsoft account.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Room for a few questions.

Which email accounts can I connect?

FocusMail supports Google and Microsoft OAuth and manual IMAP/SMTP setup. Public Google access depends on the app’s testing and verification status. Workplace administrators may also restrict access.

Do I have to use AI?

No. Reading and managing mail don’t require an AI key. Optional AI features use the server and model you configure. Read the privacy policy before sending email content to a third-party service.

Does urgency sorting send the same emails every time?

No. Prioritization is a separate manual action. Results and submission attempts are saved in the local profile, so sync and restarts don’t trigger repeat submissions. Different computers have separate caches. AI priority suggestions can be wrong or become outdated.

Can I download FocusMail yet?

FocusMail is in desktop beta. macOS has been built locally; Windows and Linux installers still need platform testing. Contact diemme89@gmail.com for beta availability. Public downloads will be linked here when ready.

What about attachments?

The current beta focuses on message text and links. Delegation forwards the latest received message’s text and links; attachments are not included.
